sources.population: Healthy Twin Study, Korea: 2672 adults/family members, 1029 men and 1643 women; excludes treatment with dyslipidemia or diabetes medication. Family and twin structure; calendar descriptions differ between abstract and methods.
sources.measurement: At least 12-hour overnight fast; EDTA plasma; Roche Cobas 6000. mg/dL. Glycerol correction not explicitly reported; equivalence to old target assay is assumed, not verified.

sources.identifier: Bansal et al. JAMA 2007;298:309-316; doi:10.1001/jama.298.3.309; admitted publisher-text snapshot
sources.population: Women's Health Study initially healthy US women aged at least 45, enrolled 1992-1995; fasting subset 20118 (self-reported >=8 hours). Only fasting descriptive data used.
sources.measurement: EDTA plasma; enzymatic TG assay corrected for endogenous glycerol; Hitachi 917 with Roche reagents/calibrators; mg/dL. Old-target-assay equivalence remains a transport assumption.
